Method of Attack: FateGrab is an FTP file stealer targeting documents and emails of various file formats including '.txt', '.rtf', '.xls', '.xlsx', '.ods', '.cmd', '.pdf', '.vbs', '.ps1', '.one', '.kdb', '.kdbx', '.doc', '.docx', '.odt', '.eml', '.msg', '.email'.
StealDeal is an information stealer malware that can steal internet browsing data and passwords stored on the web browser.
Impacted Systems: Systems using the 'DELTA' situational awareness program by the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense
Attack Vector: Phishing emails and instant messages with fake certificate update warnings containing a ZIP archive with malicious executables
Indicators of Compromise: Emails containing PDF documents with certificate installation instructions
Use of VMProtect to protect EXE and DLL files
